## Plan
Took the scaffolded Cake Co site to a working v1. I closed a checkout pricing hole, gave staff real order and cake management, and added order tracking for customers.

## Files
- `lib/orders.ts`, `app/api/orders/route.ts` (modify): the server sets every price from the database and checks dates, options and quantities
- `app/admin/orders/[id]`, `app/admin/cakes/[id]` (create): order detail with a baking list, and cake plus options editing
- `app/admin/page.tsx`, `app/admin/actions.ts` (modify): order filters, edit links, safe sample removal, new cakes come with starter options
- `app/orders/[id]`, `StatusTracker.tsx`, `CartWaiting.tsx`, `account/orders` (modify/create): progress tracker, a link back to the saved cart, sign out
- `Header.tsx`, `page.tsx`, `signin/page.tsx`, `CheckoutForm.tsx` (modify): mobile nav, empty-menu state, 24h lead time
- `globals.css`, `tailwind.config.ts` (modify): brand color tints now actually render

## Tests
No test suite · risk_class: medium

## Verification
Typecheck clean and the build is clean. I ran the app against a local test database. A tampered order was stored at the real price ($126.00, not $0.01). Bad dates, made-up options and signed-out requests were all rejected. Admin pages returned 200 for staff and 404 for customers. Not verified: the admin form submits themselves (I only tested their SQL). Online payment is NOT done because no payment processor is connected.

## How to review
Start with `createOrder` in `lib/orders.ts`. That's where the real prices get applied.

parsed.body:
## What changed

**Checkout pricing is now set by the server (security fix).** Before this, `createOrder` saved whatever prices the browser sent (`basePriceCents` / `priceDeltaCents`), so a customer could order a $126 cake for a penny. `POST /api/orders` now reads only the cake id, quantity, chosen option kind+label and message. It looks up the base price and option prices in the database inside the order transaction, and rejects hidden cakes, made-up options, duplicate option kinds, quantities over 20 and carts over 20 lines.

**Date checks.** Pickup or delivery must be at least 24 hours out and no more than 180 days ahead, checked on both the server and the form (the form sets a `min` on the date picker). Error codes are mapped to plain-language messages on the checkout form.

**Staff admin.**
- `/admin` shows orders as a list with Open / New / All filters. Open orders are sorted by pickup or delivery time, and the page shows how many new orders are waiting.
- New `/admin/orders/[id]` page: customer name, phone and email (tap to call or email), pickup or delivery details, a "what to bake" list (every option plus the message on top), totals, a status control and a status history.
- New `/admin/cakes/[id]` page: edit name, description, price, occasions, dietary tags and whether the cake shows in the shop. Staff can also add or remove customization choices.
- Adding a cake now gives it a starter set of sizes, flavors and frostings so it can be ordered right away, handles duplicate names with slug suffixes (before, a duplicate name crashed), and goes straight to the edit page.
- "Remove sample cakes" deletes sample cakes nobody has ordered and hides any that are on an order, all in one transaction.
- `updateOrderStatus` locks the order row, ignores unknown orders and skips writing a history entry when the status hasn't changed.

**Customer side.**
- Order page shows a progress tracker (Received, Confirmed, In the kitchen, Ready or Out for delivery, Enjoyed), a headline that changes with the status, and the subtotal and delivery fee. Signed-out visitors are sent to sign in instead of seeing a 404.
- `/account/orders` adds a "your cart is waiting" link back to checkout after sign-in, a sign-out button (logout could not be reached anywhere before), and shows the invite error message.
- Checkout pre-fills name and phone from the customer's last order.
- Mobile header now has Shop, Sign in or My orders, and Admin links. These were hidden below the `sm` breakpoint, so on a phone only the cart was reachable.
- Home: the featured-cake button no longer points at a hard-coded sample cake (it would 404 once samples were removed), there's an empty state when no cakes are live, and a new "How ordering works" section.
- Sign-in: removed the Name field, which the signup route ignored. The invite token is now validated and URL-encoded in the tab links.

**Design token fix (was already broken).** The Tailwind colors were `var(--x)` hex values, so opacity modifiers like `bg-accent/10`, `from-accent/20` and `bg-bg/80` were not being generated at all (confirmed by checking the compiled CSS). The colors are now declared as `rgb(var(--x-rgb) / <alpha-value>)` with RGB channel variables, and the same colors are unchanged.

**Times.** Order times are shown in `BUSINESS_TIME_ZONE` (America/Los_Angeles) with a zone label, not the server's UTC.

## Verification
- `tsc --noEmit`: 0 errors. `next build`: clean, 16 routes.
- Ran `scripts/migrate.mjs` and `next start` against a local Postgres-compatible test database (PGlite): both migrations applied.
- Signup returned 303 to a relative `/account/orders` with the session cookie.
- A tampered order (base price $0.01, option price -$99.99) was stored at the real price: $114.00 subtotal + $12.00 delivery = $126.00.
- A date 1 hour out returned `bad_date` 400, a made-up option `option_unavailable` 400, an unknown cake `cake_unavailable` 400, and a signed-out request 401.
- Non-admin: `/admin` 404. Admin: `/admin`, `/admin/orders/1` and `/admin/cakes/1` returned 200, with the correct $56.00 total, options, message and contact details.
- Ran the SQL for sample removal and adding an option directly: the ordered sample cake was kept and hidden, the rest were deleted, and the home page showed the empty state.
- **Not exercised end-to-end:** the admin server-action form posts themselves (tested only their SQL).

### Adjacent issues (not fixed)
- Payment: the stated policy is payment up front, but there is no payment processor, so orders are created as `pending` and staff mark them paid by hand. Checkout copy tells customers we'll contact them to arrange payment.
- The cart login throttle lives in memory for one process (fine at one instance).
- Footer Privacy and Contact links are still `#` placeholders.
parsed.title: Cake Co v1: server-side order pricing, staff order and cake management, order tracking

parsed.customer_summary: Your cake site now works end to end. Customers can customize a cake, pick a pickup or delivery time at least a day ahead, and follow their order from oven to door. Your staff can see exactly what to bake, update each order's status, and edit cakes and their options. I also fixed a checkout flaw that would have let someone change a cake's price, and made the site easier to get around on a phone. Online payment isn't connected yet, so for now your team confirms each order and arranges payment directly with the customer.
